# M6-S7: a ?-chain in a for condition or post statement, in a case guard, or in
# a go child runs per evaluation natively and ejected. test/logos/run is the
# single source: each .out file is the expected output of the native build and
# of the ejected tree, which builds with plain go and stays gofmt-clean.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_attacks.lgo a/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_hoist_scope.lgo b/main.lgo

# Loop, switch, select, and group attacks.
cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_attacks.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_attacks.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

# Scope fixture: condition, post, guard, fallthrough, and group child chains.
cd b
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_hoist_scope.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_hoist_scope.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainguardsa

go 1.27
-- b/go.mod --
module example.com/chainguardsb

go 1.27
